_comment: Example R1 admission-suite vectors for SpendBudgetAdapter. Distinct subjects per vector -- each subject's cumulativeSpentWei starts at 0, so these are independent, not sequential against one running total. Sized against the reference constructor (perOpBudgetWei = 1 ether, cumulativeBudgetWei = 3 ether) used by both IntegrityAccountTest and DeployKernelReference.s.sol.
